topic: Core game loop (act, feedback, reward, harder) vs standalone badges
hook: Stop adding badges. Users quit without a 4-step loop.

lines.say: Users quit without a four-step loop.
Every good game runs the same loop: act, get feedback, earn a reward, face a harder challenge.
Then again. A little harder each lap.

caption:
Stop adding badges. Users quit without a 4-step loop. Follow for more game design you can steal.

Every good game runs the same core loop:

1. Act
2. Get feedback
3. Earn a reward
4. Face a harder challenge

Then again, a little harder each lap. A badge is one reward with no loop around it. The loop is what builds user engagement.

Badges are stickers. Loops are games. That's gamification.
